en.headline: 6 commits in sopen-translate; 13 automated commits in sogeisetsu
en.summary: On 2026-10-23 the user made **6 own commits**, all in `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate`, plus **13 automated commits** by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. In `sopen-translate`, the work covered performance and correctness: page handling now batches by provider policy with bounded concurrency and adaptive splitting, and options/popup fixes keep the model cache TTL honest and guard the restore status fetch. A 797-entry offline-built builtin glossary term list was shipped, and release chores bumped the project to `0.2.0` with docs synced to the bilingual/glossary work. Documentation also included recording C6 real-device acceptance results, and locally installed agent skills were added to ignore rules. No pull requests, reviews, issues, releases, stars or discussions were recorded, and no section of the collection was truncated.

zh.headline: sopen-translate 提交 6 次，sogeisetsu 另有 13 次自动提交
zh.summary: 2026-10-23，用户共完成 **6 次本人提交**，全部位于 `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate`；`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中另有 **13 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 完成的自动提交**。在 `sopen-translate` 中，改动兼顾性能与正确性：页面处理改为按 provider 策略批量处理，并加入有界并发与自适应拆分；options 与 popup 的修复使模型缓存 TTL 保持准确，并为恢复状态请求加上保护。当天还发布了含 797 条词条的离线构建内置术语表，并通过发布相关提交将版本升至 `0.2.0`，文档同步更新以反映双语与术语表相关工作。文档方面还记录了 C6 真机验收结果，本地安装的 agent skills 被加入忽略规则。当天未记录拉取请求、评审、issue、发布、star 或讨论；各采集部分均未被截断。
